Radiation Dose Volume Data
=======================

The Radiation Dose Volume Data module records detailed dosimetric information for radiation treatment volumes.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Volume Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Radiotherapy Link**: Associated radiation therapy course
* **Volume Name**: Name of the structure being measured
* **Volume Type**: Classification of the volume

Measurements
^^^^^^^^^^
* **Absolute Volume**: Size in cubic centimeters
* **Relative Volume**: Percentage of total volume
* **Volume Units**: Units of measurement

Dose Data
^^^^^^^^
* **Absolute Dose**: Radiation dose received
* **Relative Dose**: Percentage of prescribed dose
* **Prescribed Dose**: Target dose for this volume
* **Dose Units**: Units for radiation measurement

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Data Recording:

   #. Use consistent units  
   #. Document all required metrics  
   #. Note any constraints or limits  

2. Quality Assurance:

   #. Verify measurements  
   #. Document any deviations  
   #. Track dose objectives
